instruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de envelope
prompt: Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a luxurious decorative envelope as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying a strong central presence in the frame. The envelope is elegant, premium and refined, designed in a sophisticated black and gold palette, with realistic paper texture, soft matte finish, subtle fibers, and luxurious metallic gold accents. The envelope includes precise folds, clean geometry, and an ornate wax seal or embossed emblem in gold, creating a tactile and high-end appearance. It is placed within a rich, story-driven environment, not a flat backdrop. The background forms a narrative scene — such as an elegant nocturnal ballroom, a refined dark marble interior, or a luxurious candlelit setting — softly blurred but visually recognizable. Architectural details, decorative shadows or subtle ornaments create depth and context while keeping the envelope as the clear hero. Surrounding elements are carefully curated and symbolic, including delicate black feathers, gold dust, floating particles, subtle sparkles, or elegant floral accents, arranged organically around the envelope. These elements feel natural, suspended gently, enhancing motion and sophistication without overpowering the composition. Lighting is cinematic and dramatic, with soft key light illuminating the envelope, delicate rim light outlining its edges in gold, and subtle volumetric light rays enhancing the luxurious mood. Soft atmospheric haze and floating particles catch the light, creating a premium, elegant atmosphere. Shadows are soft, realistic and directional. The color palette is intentional and harmonious, centered on black, deep charcoal, rich gold, and warm metallic highlights, with smooth gradients, luminous reflections and controlled contrast. Composition: foreground-focused, envelope sharply in focus, background softly defocused, strong sense of depth and perspective. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on envelope texture, seal and ornaments, cinematic bokeh in background lights. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic realism, elegant, luxurious, premium invitation aesthetic. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, visually enchanting, suitable for premium invitations and elegant storytelling visuals.
folhaInstruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de de uma folha em branco com adornos em torno, sendo essa folha o objeto central e principal da imagem, ocupando quase a tela toda, mas ainda deixando espaço para visualizar o chão, o fundo e os elementos laterais
folhaPrompt: Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a blank elegant sheet of paper as the main subject, positioned centrally in the foreground and occupying almost the entire frame, while still leaving enough visible space around it to reveal the floor, background and lateral elements. The sheet feels premium, refined and handcrafted, with realistic paper texture, soft matte surface, subtle fibers, clean edges and a luxurious presence. The paper is perfectly blank, pristine and ready for design, with no text, no markings, no logos, no watermarks, no stains. Ornamental adornments surround the sheet in a tasteful and balanced way, framing it without overpowering it: delicate golden filigree, refined metallic flourishes, elegant decorative corners, subtle embossed motifs, fine ornamental lines and sophisticated accents arranged organically along the sides and upper/lower edges. The composition is rich and story-driven, not a flat backdrop, with a luxurious environment that enhances the central object — an elegant dark-toned setting with a polished floor, softly visible architectural or decorative background elements, and side details that create depth and visual context while keeping the blank sheet as the clear hero. The surrounding scene should feel upscale, ceremonial and editorial, with the black and gold palette dominating the visual identity: deep matte blacks, glossy obsidian surfaces, warm metallic gold highlights, subtle amber reflections and controlled contrast. Lighting is cinematic and dramatic, with a soft key light illuminating the blank sheet, delicate rim light outlining its edges and golden ornaments, and subtle volumetric light rays creating a premium atmosphere. Shadows are soft, realistic and directional, with gentle reflections on the floor and metallic accents. Add atmospheric depth with faint haze, floating dust particles and subtle sparkle accents catching the light, enhancing elegance without clutter. Composition: foreground-focused, blank sheet sharply in focus, ornaments highly detailed, background softly defocused but still recognizable, strong sense of depth and perspective, the sheet occupying nearly the full screen while preserving visible floor, background and side elements. Camera: editorial macro / close-up cinematic look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on paper texture and gold ornament details, luxurious bokeh in background highlights. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, elegant, premium, cinematic luxury design aesthetic, sophisticated and minimal yet ornate. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range, premium editorial rendering quality. Aspect ratio: 9:16.
cartaoPrompt: Gere um cartão na horizontal elegante nessa mesma atmosfera e mesmo tema (Elegante) e mesma paleta de cor (Preto e Dourado), escrito apenas Júlio e Andreza.
aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
A animação começa focando em um envelope fechado com um único selo de cera. Assim que o selo de cera se desprende fisicamente e cai no chão, ele não é substituído, duplicado nem regenerado em momento algum. O envelope permanece permanentemente aberto após esse instante, sem que surja qualquer outro selo.
Uma vez removido o selo, a aba do envelope se levanta lentamente. De seu interior, emergem brilhos cintilantes, poeira brilhante e rastros de luz radiante, espalhando-se pelo ambiente em um espetáculo hipnotizante, com feixes mágicos de partículas luminosas que se curvam em torno do envelope, passando à sua frente e por trás em um movimento contínuo. Essas partículas originam-se apenas de dentro do envelope, aumentando em densidade e luminosidade à medida que se deslocam.
A luz radiante se intensifica e se expande para fora, preenchendo gradualmente toda a cena. Nenhum novo objeto físico é introduzido durante essa transição. O brilho intenso dos feixes e das partículas transforma-se em uma tela branca sólida e deslumbrante no quadro final. A câmera aplica um zoom sutil e lento.
